judge_output.response:
**Article 109 – Annual Leave (Saudi Labor Law)**  

| Aspect | Policy rule | Conditions / requirements | Exceptions | Source |
|--------|-------------|---------------------------|------------|--------|
| **Paid leave** | Annual leave is a paid leave and the wage must be paid in advance. | Applies to any employee’s annual‑leave entitlement. | The payment is subject to the employer’s applicable payroll arrangements. | [Source: LAW039] |
| **Timing of use** | Employees should take their annual leave during the calendar year in which it becomes due. | Applies to the employee’s annual‑leave entitlement. | Postponement is allowed only under the conditions set out in Article 110. | [Source: LAW040] |
| **Employer scheduling** | The employer may set the dates of annual leave (or rotate leave) to meet work‑requirements and maintain business operations. | The employer must comply with statutory notice requirements when scheduling. | The employee’s statutory right to the leave remains unaffected. | [Source: LAW042] |

**Summary:**
